metric: Unsafe-rewrite pairs from the fuzzing suite that may differ (NOT IN versus anti-join, outer-join filters, COUNT over empty input, join duplicates, UNION versus UNION ALL) treated as faulty variants; one random seed catches 48/51, 8 random databases 51/51, the suite 51/51.
correctness: Each kill repeats on both sides on a database; the pairs are the fuzzing thread's committed cases (tests/fixtures/unsafe_rewrite_cases.jsonl, expect either/different).
held_out: the fixture's held-out families are included in the 51 and scored the same way
caveats: Easy for every strategy; the gain is size: median counterexample 2 rows for the suite versus 25 for 8 random databases. Pairs the fixture marks equivalent are not faults and are skipped.
